def maior_retangulo_histograma(alturas):
    if not alturas:
        return 0
    
    max_area = 0
    stack = []
    
    for i, h in enumerate(alturas):
        # While stack is not empty and current height is less than stack top
        while stack and h < alturas[stack[-1]]:
            height = alturas[stack.pop()]
            width = i if not stack else i - stack[-1] - 1
            max_area = max(max_area, height * width)
        stack.append(i)
    
    # Process remaining elements in stack
    while stack:
        height = alturas[stack.pop()]
        width = len(alturas) if not stack else len(alturas) - stack[-1] - 1
        max_area = max(max_area, height * width)
    
    return max_area
